_what_this_is: CVBS site visit records. Generated by scripts/site-visit-intake.py from the photographs themselves. The visit date is read off the photo's own metadata, never typed in.
_the_one_rule: Write every note as FIT, not FAULT. Venues pay our commission. 'Comfortable at 200, tight at 400' reads as expertise and a venue would forward it. 'The room is too small' reads as a review and earns Karen a phone call. Say what the room suits, and who it does not suit, never what is wrong with it.
_also: No identifiable delegates without a release. No other client's branded event in frame. GPS is stripped from every published file.
